measurement: Equal-weight accepted checkpoints within each group; not estimated effort, live health or whole-project completion. Local tests alone do not close runtime checkpoints. Scope changes require a dated rebaseline.

checkpoints.goal: Reviewed maintenance inventory and candidate plan
Private configuration backup and owner-confirmed console recovery access (not full restore proof)
Reviewed updates and installed targets verified
Scanner installed and restart requirements assessed
Owner-confirmed reboot and clear guest postcheck
Supervisor foundation and spare native client configuration accepted
Dedicated non-admin Windows account, protected storage and exact-account empty-agent probe accepted
Protected key custody and pinned restricted OpenSSH authentication under exact account accepted
Production supervisor and scheduled startup installed and verified
Managed VPS lifecycle, effective route and deliberate disable verified
Installed system process and network interruption/recovery accepted
Actual wrong-key/host/listener/destination/TLS negative cases accepted
Managed-system duplicate-start, cancellation and persistent stop accepted
Exact-account logoff/cold-boot recovery with no authority replay accepted
Clock/health drift policy, observability and application no-direct-fallback accepted
Current provider auth/callback contract and app configuration verified
Owner login and required authentication completed through reviewed flow
Callback binding, validation and invalid/replayed callback rejection accepted
Secret-safe token custody and authenticated read-only access accepted
Expiry, revocation, restart and relogin behavior accepted
Instrument mapping and data entitlement verified
Actual fresh timestamped market-hours quote retrieval accepted
Stale, missing and malformed quote rejection accepted
Provider error, rate-limit and reconnect behavior accepted
Application quote provenance and no-fallback/read-only integration accepted
Real authorized ACCEPT with current quote/account/risk checks records review only
Real REJECT accepted without order, reservation or fill
100-second expiry and stale/out-of-zone rejection accepted
Duplicate/replayed actions cannot duplicate outcomes
Unauthorized actions rejected with consistent audit and no execution
